//go:build sessionless_mcp_offline

package providerloopsession

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/x509"
	"net"
	"net/netip"
)

// ConfigureMCPOfflineNetwork is present ONLY in the overlay test binary. The
// temporary atomic claim serializes inert setup against Run; it cannot reset an
// already claimed invocation or install a Store/keeper/prepared authority.
func (v *CredentialedV1) ConfigureMCPOfflineNetwork(lookup func(context.Context, string) ([]netip.Addr, error), dial func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error), roots *x509.CertPool) error {
	if v == nil || v.state == nil || v.state.session == nil || v.state.session.state == nil || !v.state.claimed.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
		return ErrSession
	}
	defer v.state.claimed.Store(false)
	s := v.state.session.state
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if !s.credentialed || s.closed || s.started || s.attempted || s.runtimeStarted || s.entry != nil || s.keeper == nil || s.ctx == nil || s.ctx.Err() != nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	return s.keeper.ConfigureMCPOfflineNetwork(lookup, dial, roots)
}

// The noauth variant exists only in this additive offline overlay. It acquires
// the SAME original session gate, and can configure only an inert invocation.
func (v *LocalV1) ConfigureMCPOfflineNetwork(lookup func(context.Context, string) ([]netip.Addr, error), dial func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error), roots *x509.CertPool) error {
	if v == nil || v.state == nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	s := v.state
	select {
	case s.gate <- struct{}{}:
	default:
		return ErrBusy
	}
	defer func() { <-s.gate }()
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.credentialed || s.closed || s.started || s.attempted || s.runtimeStarted || s.entry != nil || s.keeper == nil || s.ctx == nil || s.ctx.Err() != nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	return s.keeper.ConfigureMCPOfflineNetwork(lookup, dial, roots)
}
